title: Welcome Panel: Micro-checklist & Photographic Empty-state Mockups
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact welcome panel asset pack for the Console that combines a bite-sized micro-checklist, photographic-style empty-state hero variants, and three tooltip/tip severity variants. Deliverables include high-fidelity PNG/SVG exports, Lottie micro-animations for the checklist pulse, annotated handoff tokens, and a screenshot masking guide for engineering QA. Focus is on first-time user clarity while preserving minimal vertical real estate in the console header area.
comments: 2026-03-06 Maya Chen: Initial exploration complete — two visual directions: 1) photographic hero with soft gradient overlay, 2) illustrative hero with line art. Leaning toward photographic direction for higher perceived legitimacy in enterprise contexts.

2026-03-07 Liam O'Connor: Reviewed explorations; asked for a compact micro-checklist pattern that fits under 120px height in the header while remaining keyboard-navigable. Flagged potential conflicts with existing header CTA spacing.
2026-03-09 Maya Chen: Produced high-fidelity frames and Lottie pulse animation. Added a11y notes: focus ring, 2.5:1 contrast for microtext, ARIA-live region for dynamic checklist updates.
2026-03-10 PM Arjun Patel: Requested inclusion of an A/B test plan to measure 7-day activation lift (micro-checklist vs. classic checklist). Added to ticket dependencies.

2026-03-11 Design critique (cross-team): Feedback to reduce microcopy by 10% and provide an optional 'snooze' action for the checklist. Also requested localized copy slots and variable-length layout tests.
2026-03-12 UX Writer Nina Gomez: Submitted final copy variants (short/verbos) and localization notes for EN/FR/DE/JP. Recommended keeping action verbs present tense.
2026-03-13 Liam O'Connor: Updated handoff package with exported tokens and CSS snippets. Raised two follow-ups under ENG-4321 and ENG-4380 for screenshot masking and keyboard focus behavior.

2026-03-13 QA Rajiv Mehta: Quick QA pass found a 1px misalignment in desktop expanded checklist; captured in screenshot shots/welcome-desktop-checklist-expanded-bug.png. Tagging for patch prior to rollout.
notes: Accessibility: ensure Lottie falls back to static SVG and exposes descriptive aria-label. Motion timeout 300ms, reduced-motion preference respected.
Performance: use optimized WebP for photographic hero on supported browsers, lazy-load heavy assets behind first interaction.
Analytics: fire events 'welcome_shown', 'microchecklist_action', 'welcome_snoozed' with route and user_tier. Coordinate with analytics team for schema.
A/B testing: variant A (micro-checklist compact), variant B (classic full checklist). Primary metric: activation rate at +7 days. Secondary: time-to-first-action, dismissal rate.
Handoff: include exported tokens (spacing, color, type) and a 1-page dev checklist in screenshot_masking_guide.pdf for reproducible screenshots in e2e tests.
